# Third-party dependencies

`godot-cpp` is a Git submodule pinned to
`fbbf9ec4efd8f1055d00edb8d926eef8ba4c2cce` (Godot 4.3 stable bindings).
Its upstream MIT license remains in the checkout. Initialize with
`git submodule update --init --recursive`; do not advance it implicitly.
No vendored proprietary game libraries or assets belong here.
